title: PREMARKET LIVE: The Trading Floor | Stock Market Outlook
speaker: Arete Trading host

macro_themes.theme: Rotation out of semis into software
macro_themes.view: Selling semis/DRAM after the OpenAI news and rotating into software in an 'anti-AI trade'; may get a sell signal on semis today or this week.
Banks' bond portfolios likely took big mark-to-market losses as yields moved; prefers to trade banks after earnings, gut likes JPM bouncing.
Bond market closed (Columbus Day) so late volume, then CPI the next day; indices rejecting October point of control.
